paite: Huan Hezekiah in Israel gam leh Judah gam teng ah mi asawl a, Ephraim leh Manasseh gamte ah leng TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a hong pai ding in lai akhak hi.
heading: Paikan Kut Kisakkholhna
english: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Kumpipa leh amiliante leh Jerusalem a mipi teng in akha nihna ah, Paikan Ankuang neih asawm uhi.
english: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

paite: Huai lai in alui thei nai kei ua, siampu kihihsiangthoute atam nai kei uh; Jerusalem a mipi akikaihkhop nai louh ziak un.
english: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

paite: Athil sawm uh kumpipa leh mipite ngaih in adik hi.
english: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.

paite: Huchi in Israel gam teng, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan pha in TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a hong pai ding apuang ding in thu ahihkipta hi. Adan bangtak in huchibang a tam in ahih ngei nai kei uh.
english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

paite: Huchi in lai taipih mite kumpipa leh amiliante uh lai tawi in, Israel leh Judah gam tengteng a pai ding in kumpipa thupiak bang in apawt ua, "Nou Israel suante aw, Siria kumpipate khut a kipan pawt a akhosuaksunte TOUPA, Abraham, Isak leh Israel' Pathian lam hong nga nawn un; huchi a nou lam ahong ngat nawn theihna ding in.
english: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

paite: Nou zaw na pi-le-pute uh leh na unaute uh, TOUPA apipute uh Pathian tung a thil hihkhial a om, segawp ding a donsak lou a na muhte uh bang in om kei un.
english: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against Yahweh, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.

paite: Na pi-le-pute uh bang in genhak nawn kei unla, TOUPA kiang ah kitulut zaw unla, tangtawn a dia ahihsiangthou, amun siangthou ah hong lut unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem un, huchi in ahehna thupitak na lak ua kipan akiheimangsak ding hi.
english: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve Yahweh your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

paite: TOUPA lam na hong ngat nawn uleh na unaute uh leh na tate uh sal a man mite'n ahehpih ding ua, hiai gam ah ahong pai nawn ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh lah chingtheitak leh zahngaitheitak ahi ngal a, amah lam na hong ngat peuhmah uleh ahon nuse kei ding,” chi in.
english: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

paite: Huchi in lai taipih mite kho chih ah Ephraim leh Manasseh gam tengteng ah Zebulun pha in apai ua, himahleh amaute nuihsan in ana simmoh uhi.
english: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.

paite: Himahleh Asherte leh Manassehte leh Zebulunte tampi akitulut ua, Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
english: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

paite: Judah gamte ngial houh TOUPA thu a kumpipa leh miliante thupiak zui ding in Pathian in lungsim mun khat apusak hi.
english: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huchi in kha nihna ah tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, atam mahmah uhi.
heading: Paikan Kut Zatna
english: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.

paite: Huan athou ua, Jerusalem a maitamte ala ua, gimlim halna maitamte leng ala ua, Kidron lui ah apai uhi.
english: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

paite: Huchi in akha nihna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina agou ua; siampute leh Levite azum ua, akihihsiangthou ua, halmang thillat toh TOUPA' inn ah alalut uhi.
english: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huan Pathian mipa Mosi Dan bangtak in amau mun chiat ah adingh ua; siampute'n Levite a kipan atan uh sisan atheh uhi.
english: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

paite: Mipi lak ah lah kihihsiangthou lou atam ua; huaiziak in TOUPA a ding a hihsiangthou ding in asiangthouloute tuam ding in Levite'n Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou uhi.
english: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to Yahweh.

paite: Ephraim, Manasseh, Issakar, Zebulun mite tampi akihihsiangthou kei na ua, dan lou bang in Paikan Ankuangluina ane uhi. Himahleh amaute a ding in Hezekiah athum a, "Chingthei ToUPA'N,
english: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good Yahweh pardon everyone

paite: Michih alungtang a TOUPA, apipute Pathian, Pathian zongte, mun siangthou siansakna dan dungzui in kisiangsak kei mahleh, ngaidam hen," chi in.
english: who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Hezekiah thumna angaikhia a, mipite ahihdamta hi.
english: Yahweh listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

paite: Israel mi Jerusalem a omte'n Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nuamsatak in ni sagih azang ua; Levite leh siampute'n kaihging ngaihtak toh TOUPA pahtawi a la sa in niteng in TOUPA aphat uhi.
english: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised Yahweh day by day, singing with loud instruments to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in siamtak in TOUPA kilawmtak a phat Levite alungmuan hi. Huchi in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian kiang a thupha tawi in lemna thillatte lan in ni sagih ankuangluina ane tawntung uhi.
english: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of Yahweh. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan mipi in ni sagih dang ankuang lui nawn asawm ua; huchi in ni sagih dang nuamsatak in ankuang alui nawn uhi.
heading: Paikan Kut Lop Hun Behlapna
english: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangsagih goh ding in apia a; miliante'n mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam singkhat apia uhi; siampu tampite akihihsiangthou uhi.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

paite: Huchi in Judah mipi tengteng siampute toh Levite toh, Israel gam a kipan a mipi hong pai tengteng leh namdang Israel gam a kipan a hong pai Judah gam a omte'n nuam asa mahmah uhi.
english: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

paite: Huchi in nopsakna thupitak Jerusalem ah a-om a: Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon chiang ah huchibang himhim Jerusalem ah a-om ngei nai kei hi.
english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in siampu leh Levite athou ua, mipite avualzawl ua; a-aw uh ngaihkhiak in a-om a, athumna un a-omna siangthou van apha hi.
english: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.
